name: Aurora
source:
Likes: Shiro. Well, she's my only friend...
Favorite Things: Moonlit night walks, sun-bathing.
Hobbies: I don't need hobbies. 
Strong points: I'm good at anything 
Weak points: I have none.
Dogs or Cats? ⇒ Naturally, I prefer cats. Although Shiro is special.
